fusions.name: Pounce Unseen
fusions.desc: Rushes you to a target up to 7 tiles away, then deals 12 damage, leaves it 10% easier to wound for 5 seconds and makes it [Bleeding] for 2 damage a second for 5 seconds.

fusions.name: Skip Along
fusions.desc: Sends a bounding dart that deals 6 damage to the first enemy it meets, then hops to 3 more enemies within 3.5 tiles, each hit dealing 70% of the original damage. Holds 4 charges; each use spends one, and each kill restores one. For 3 seconds after using it, you move 20% faster.

fusions.name: Leap Away
fusions.desc: Steps you instantly to a point up to 8 tiles away. Using it increases your movement speed by 25% for 3 seconds.

fusions.name: Springing Habit
fusions.desc: When you spend stamina, your critical chance rises by 25% for 4 seconds. Once every 6 seconds.
